run_embed_fashion_assets: run the module to create fashion asset embeddings from a JSON metadata file using spaCy GloVe vectors
create_main_embed_assets: create fashion asset embeddings by concatenating attribute GloVe embeddings for type, color, embellishments, and pattern
run_main_clean_assets: run the main function to clean fashion assets and extract type, color, embellishments, and pattern attributes
run_main_build_vocabulary: run the main function to build a vocabulary dictionary for each fashion asset attribute field
run_main_save_embeddings: run the main function to save numpy embeddings with asset IDs and feature size to a .npy file
